Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vikram - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Neeta - 62 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Rajesh - 68 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
4. Nitin - 33 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
5. Anjali - 26 years, friend
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram stands in the ward. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "Vikram, what's the plan today?"

[Vikram folds his hands and prays for the departed soul.]

Vikram: "This is amazing!"

[Vikram sits in a wheelchair.]

Vikram: "And then?"

[Vikram walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Neeta: "I'm ready!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Vikram stands on the road. Rajesh stands near him.]

Rajesh: "So, here we are!"

[A dog runs in front of Vikram's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vikram (happily): "What happened?"

[Vikram loses his balance on the bicycle and falls.]

Rajesh: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
